_about: Public-domain T. H. Darlow, literary superintendent of the British and Foreign Bible Society, for the Word Hoard: Via Sacra, More Golden than Gold, At Home in the Bible, The Greatest Book in the World, and his life of William Robertson Nicoll. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 133 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
